title: Smoky Tofu Skewers
description: A tasty and easy-to-make recipe featuring smoky tofu on skewers, perfect for a quick dinner or lunch.
instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat (375°F).
2. Cut the tofu into 1-inch cubes and place in a shallow dish.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together the Greek vinaigrette, smoky paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
4. Pour the marinade over the tofu and coat evenly.
5. Thread the tofu, cherry tomatoes, and a few sprigs of rosemary (if using) onto the skewers.
6. Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
7. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the tofu is golden brown and the vegetables are tender.
8. Serve hot, garnished with additional rosemary if desired.
